## Rule

Periodic lattice of equal-sized cells separated by a single-pixel wall color. Cell sizes 3, 4, or 5; wall color varies (3 or 8). The single non-background, non-wall cell (the "source") that has no cross-neighbors of the same type spreads its color to all empty (0) cells in the same row AND column of the cell grid (cross pattern). Algorithm: detect period by stride-sampling, find isolated nonzero cell via Conv+Equal, spread via Conv-k_plus propagation, upsample back to full grid using 2×Gather with precomputed index table.

## Cost analysis

**v12 live cost = 197,573** (memory=196,352, params=1,221). Already FP16
internal with bool intermediates; opset 17; 146 nodes; 70 initializers.

Dominant intermediate tensors (measured 2026-05-18 via shape-inference on
the live ONNX, top-20 = 105,700 bytes ≈ 54% of memory):

| Bytes | Dtype | Shape | Op | Name | Notes |
|------:|-------|-------|------|------|-------|
| 18,000 | F16 | [1,10,30,30] | Cast | input_cast_to_239 | input → F16 |
| 18,000 | F16 | [1,10,30,30] | Mul | non_bg | input × nz_ch; fed to 2 ReduceSum + 3 Gather |
| 9,000 | BOOL | [1,10,30,30] | Equal | v8_output_raw_b | per-channel output mask |
| 9,000 | BOOL | [1,10,30,30] | And | v8_output_b | refined output mask |
| 7,200 | I64 | [1,1,30,30] | ArgMax | color_labels | argmax over channel axis |
| 7,200 | I64 | [900] | Reshape | flat_labels | flattened color_labels, feeds 4 Gathers |
| 7,200 | I64 | [1,1,30,30] | Where | v8_output_c1 | cardinal-cell write |
| 7,200 | I64 | [1,1,30,30] | Where | v8_output_c2 | diagonal-cell write |
| 3,100 | F16 | [10,155] | Cast | seen_f | seen-color one-hot pattern matrix |

The 5 large I64 lookup-table initializers (`cand_pid`, `idx_a/b/c/d` —
each (155,) int64, total ~775 params) each have exactly one consumer
(Equal_20, Gather_27, Gather_28, Gather_29, Gather_30 respectively).
Attempt 3 confirmed that converting any of these to in-graph arithmetic
worsens cost because the new vector intermediates dominate the saved
init elements.

Why is v12 hard to push lower:
1. The algorithm needs `color_labels` (ArgMax over 10 channels) as a (1,1,30,30) I64
   tensor; that's 7,200 bytes that can't easily shrink without restructuring
   pattern detection to avoid argmax → flat indexing.
2. The two F16 (1,10,30,30) tensors `input_cast_to_239` and `non_bg` together
   account for 36,000 bytes (18% of memory). Removing `non_bg` would require
   collapsing the channel multiply into the downstream ReduceSum/Gather ops, but
   they have different reduction axes so a single fused expression isn't obvious.
3. The two BOOL (1,10,30,30) v8_output masks (18,000 bytes total) are per-channel
   per-pixel; reducing them would require a different output-channel
   accumulation strategy.

Any future "materially new" task080 hypothesis must attack one of these
four buckets (input cast, non_bg multiply, ArgMax→flat indexing,
per-channel BOOL output masks). Pure init-level rewrites cannot close
the gap given memory ≫ params in score_v2.
